description: Project scaffold: uv project with cvgen entry point; ruff and pytest run
steps: uv sync
uv run cvgen --help prints commands validate and build
uv run pytest exits 0

description: JSON Schemas for content, profile, theme, locale and pii-fields files
steps: Open examples/content/cv.yaml in an editor with YAML language server
Autocompletion lists JSON Resume sections
uv run cvgen validate --content examples/content exits 0

description: Synthetic example CV covering every section, with no real personal data
steps: uv run cvgen validate --content examples/content exits 0
grep finds no email or phone pattern in examples/

description: validate reports schema errors with file, line and rule
steps: Remove work[0].startDate in a copy of the example
Run validate on the copy
Output names the file, line and missing property; exit code 1

description: PII guard rejects forbidden basics keys (name, email, phone, url, location, profiles, image)
steps: Run validate on each fixture in tests/fixtures/pii/forbidden-keys
Each exits 1 naming the key

description: PII guard rejects email, phone, CPR-like and personal profile URL patterns in any string
steps: Run validate on each fixture in tests/fixtures/pii/patterns
Each exits 1 naming file and line

description: validate --locale <code> reports every localized string missing that language
steps: Remove one da value in a copy of the example
Run validate --locale da on the copy
Exit 1 naming the file, line and key

description: Runtime prompt asks for the fields the profile requires and validates each answer
steps: Run cvgen build --profile full-en
Enter an invalid email
Prompt repeats with the format rule
Enter valid values; build continues

description: Non-interactive mode reads CVGEN_PII_* env vars and fails clearly if one is missing
steps: Unset CVGEN_PII_EMAIL
Run build with --no-input
Exit 1 naming CVGEN_PII_EMAIL

description: PII values never appear in logs, tracebacks or files outside out/
steps: Run build with synthetic PII and --verbose
grep the console output and the repo (excluding out/) for each value: no hit

description: JSON Resume export validates against the official JSON Resume schema
steps: Build full-en
Validate out/*.json against the JSON Resume 1.0.0 schema: pass

description: schema.org JSON-LD export describes a Person with roles, credentials and skills
steps: Build full-en
Parse out/*.jsonld; @type is Person; hasOccupation/hasCredential present

description: sidebar LaTeX theme places sections in sidebar and main regions from the profile
steps: Build full-en
Open out/*.pdf
Sidebar shows photo, contact, skills, languages; main shows summary, work, projects

description: PDF compiled with latexmk -lualatex -no-shell-escape in a temp dir that is deleted afterwards; A4, fonts embedded
steps: Build full-en
pdffonts shows embedded fonts; page size is A4
No .tex, .log or photo copy remains on disk outside out/

description: LaTeX special characters and injection attempts in content and prompt answers print literally
steps: Put & % $ # _ { } ~ ^ \ and \input{/etc/passwd} and \write18{id} in example strings
Build
pdftotext shows them literally; no file was read or command run

description: Profiles filter, order and limit projects and highlights
steps: Build architect-short-en
Projects count <= profile max; order is newest first

description: Locales en and da change labels, month names and babel language; {en, da} content strings resolve with fallback
steps: Build full-da
Headings are Danish; dates show Danish month names
No English text from a localized string appears

description: Computed values such as {years_experience} are filled from work dates
steps: Build full-en
Summary shows the number of years since the first work startDate

description: Markdown and plain-text (ATS) outputs
steps: Build full-en
out/*.md and out/*.txt contain every section heading and each entry's title and dates

description: PDF is tagged PDF/UA-2 and theme colors meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast
steps: Run veraPDF PDF/UA-2 profile on out/*.pdf: pass
Theme token contrast check: pass

description: Page budget: lowest-priority highlights are dropped until pageLimit fits
steps: Set pageLimit: 2 in a profile
Build
PDF has <= 2 pages and the dropped highlights have the lowest x-priority

description: CI validates, tests and builds the synthetic example; fails on any tracked PII
steps: Open a PR
Workflow is green
Push a commit adding an email to examples/: workflow fails

description: Repo guards: CI fails if content/ exists in a public repo; tracked pre-push hook refuses pushes to main
steps: Run the guard job with private=false and content/ present: fails
git push origin HEAD:main with core.hooksPath=.githooks: refused
